poses.label: Idle
poses.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / identity-preserve. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite of OLLO, the same penguin-ostrich mascot shown in the reference image. The reference is identity and material reference, NOT a layout to reproduce. One character only, no sheet, no duplicate, no text. Match its exact lovable proportions: small round white face with large violet eyes and rich purple penguin head cap, tiny warm gold beak, exactly two long curved purple head feathers, long slim white neck, plump oval white belly with purple back and two purple flipper-wings, small purple feather tail with warm gold tips, two slim gold ostrich legs and oversized rounded two-toed feet. No spots, cat ears, accessories or clothing. Same premium soft matte 3D feather texture and diffuse lighting as reference.
POSE 01 IDLE: full body, standing upright but relaxed in the reference's forward-facing three-quarter orientation, wings at sides, mouth closed in gentle smile, head tipped just slightly toward viewer. This is the neutral animation master.
IMPORTANT registration for later frames: square 1024x1024 canvas, orthographic studio character view, whole character centered x=512, feet rest at y=916, crown top about y=108, body fills about 80% canvas height, constant camera and scale, generous transparent space on all sides including room around wings. Keep both feet visible and all feathers unclipped.
Background must be COMPLETELY TRANSPARENT real alpha, including between legs and neck/wing gaps. No floor, ground shadow, drop shadow, glow, matte, backdrop, checkerboard illustration, text, border or watermark. Only Ollo's pixels, softly antialiased edges.

poses.label: Wave A
poses.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the attached transparent OLLO mascot master into ONE new transparent animation pose. This is exactly the SAME individual Ollo, not a redesign. Preserve exact head size, eyes, long thin neck, belly shape, two purple crest feathers, purple flipper-wings and gold-tipped short feather tail, gold legs, rounded two-toed feet, warm white/purple/gold colors, texture, lighting, camera, body scale, facing direction and canvas dimensions from master. Keep character registered in the same place: torso and resting feet aligned with master except for the specific motion requested. Entire body and every feather/foot must be visible. Only one Ollo, no props, letters, effects or duplicate characters. Background must have true complete transparency with clean alpha including gaps between limbs, no floor, no ground or cast shadows, no glow, no checkerboard image, no colored edge fringe. This is a sprite frame for a small friendly interface mascot.
Wave A: keep body, neck, face, legs and left-on-image wing EXACTLY as master. Raise only the wing on viewer's RIGHT beside shoulder, extending diagonally outward and up about 35 degrees in a small welcoming wave, gentle smile, mouth closed. The wave stays below the face.
